name: Isabella Falcone
source:
A newer member of the board at Dante's Enterprise, with a six-percent holding. Isabella approached you after the meeting to say you had disappointed her and to suggest you should not give up. You cannot yet tell whether that was encouragement, provocation, or an invitation to prove useful.

[In game description]
